name: Stairs

numSteps.label: Steps
numSteps.desc: Number of steps in the flight, which is what sets both its rise and its run: the slope is fixed at the standard 0.178 m rise over a 0.28 m tread, so a flight grows along the diagonal rather than getting steeper. Count the steps you need to reach the deck.

showHandrails.label: Handrails
showHandrails.desc: Handrails up both sides of the flight.

color.label: Steel color
color.desc: Steel tint of the stringers and rails.
